Game Overview

In Aisa vs Dragon Bots, the core idea is straightforward: embark on a thrilling journey with Aisa bot, collecting red balls while dodging relentless Dragon bots, perilous traps, and fire. Each of the eight levels intensifies as you strive to reach the exit and advance, challenging your platforming prowess. Adventure awaits as danger lurks at every turn!
